highlights: Retail 1 Premiumisation and Retail Expansion to Drive Growth Est.

Actual for Q2FY27: Revenue – BEAT; EBITDA – MISS; PAT – MISS Changes in Estimates Post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: -2%/-3%; EBITDA: -15%/-20%; PAT: -25%/-29% Recommendation Rationale • Revenue Growth Driven by Pricing and Product Mix: Relaxo reported ~12% YoY revenue growth, driven by higher realisations and a favourable product mix, with average realisation increasing to Rs 186 from Rs 151 YoY.
Growth remained broad-based across channels, supported by its diversified brand portfolio and extensive distribution network.
Going forward, premiumisation and sports footwear are expected to be key growth drivers.
valuation: Result Update 17th November, 2026 HOLD Target Price 300 Relaxo Footwears Ltd.

The company remains focused on expanding its retail footprint, targeting 500 EBOs by FY27-end. • Margins Remain Under Pressure: Relaxo’s profitability continues to face pressure from elevated and volatile raw material prices, particularly rubber, which has reached a record high of Rs 300/kg, along with rising labour costs amid the ongoing West Asia conflict.

Current Valuation: 47x Sep’28E EPS (Earlier Valuation: 52x Jun’28E EPS ) Current TP: Rs 300/share (Earlier TP: Rs 450) Recommendation: With a 6% upside from the CMP, we maintain our HOLD rating on the stock.
watch: Going forward, premiumisation and sports footwear are expected to be key growth drivers.

The company will continue to make selective investments in brand building, distribution and retail expansion. • Demand Outlook: Relaxo remains cautiously optimistic about demand in H2FY27, while closely monitoring raw material price volatility and evolving consumer preferences.
